items.question: In the UAE, what is the maximum share of a company's shares that can be offered through initial public offerings after converting into a joint stock company under the commercial companies law reform?
items.gold: Up to 70 per cent of shares, subject to approval from the relevant authorities.
items.fact: Joint stock conversion IPO limit raised from 30 to 70 percent.

items.question: What percentage of ownership of onshore mainland companies may foreign investors hold under Federal Decree-Law No. 26 of 2020 in the UAE?
items.gold: 100 per cent foreign ownership of mainland companies.
items.fact: Decree-Law 26 of 2020 allows 100 percent foreign ownership onshore.
